diagnoses.finding: The B0 staged controller selected a stage from the logical iteration index but stopped the attempt immediately when global deterministic structural QA passed.
diagnoses.evidence: tracepixel-staged-v1 averaged exactly 1.0 iteration and 0 revisions across all 14 trials, so later stage-loop contexts were never reached after the initial silhouette iteration.

diagnoses.finding: Global structural correctness was insufficient as an authoring-completion signal.
diagnoses.evidence: Both methods had 1.0 completion and structural pass rates, while owner-blind perceptual means and rejection counts diverged materially.

diagnoses.finding: The lower staged token, changed-pixel, and wall-time means cannot be claimed as efficiency superiority because staged execution terminated before later authoring stages.
diagnoses.evidence: Staged means were lower while perceptual scores were also substantially lower and 5/14 staged artifacts were rejected.

architecture_followups.action: Decouple staged authoring completion from global deterministic all-rules-pass; required stages must be explicitly applied or skipped before final authoring completion.
Introduce a versioned feedback/finding intake that keeps deterministic QA facts and owner perceptual feedback as separate authorities and can localize an affected stage/region.
Generate bounded minimal repair PixelPrograms instead of implicit whole-asset regeneration, then re-run deterministic QA.
Record stage coverage, changed pixels, changed operations, revision cost, and unaffected-region stability so under-authoring cannot masquerade as efficiency.
Evaluate post-B0 architecture changes only on a newly preregistered held-out B1 cohort; never rerun or relabel B0 to improve its score.

claim_boundary: B0 is development-visible matched architecture evidence. It supports no composite winner and no claim that TracePixel staged authoring is perceptually superior.
